logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators.

scenes.heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.

segments.label: POLICE CONSTABLE (Authoritative, Stern)
segments.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
segments.text: Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.

segments.label: LORD STERLING (Snarls, Outraged)
segments.speaker: LORD STERLING
segments.text: You have no authority!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

segments.label: POLICE CONSTABLE (Cold, Definite)
segments.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
segments.text: I have more than enough.

scenes.heading: INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Shouting)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Get your hands off me! Catherine!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Screaming)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Do something!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Do you know what this did to me?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I mourned you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I waited for you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I never stopped loving you.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You don't remember?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You were never my Duchess.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: But I loved you!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: No!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I loved you before all this!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Did you?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Her?!
